## Description

Follow up on #1750, #1751 and #1756 to make Qwen Flash Next multimodal RL reliable with Arena and colocated SGLang/Megatron execution.

- Preserve original prompt/generated token IDs, multimodal masks and image tensors through proxy exports and context recovery; correctly distinguish generated special IDs from real image placeholders.
- Preserve frozen PLE/vision state and validate sharded visual checkpoints; keep valid rollout groups through Arena transient retries and classify native context-budget/model failures consistently.
- Fix colocated pause handling and remove diagnostic-only batch replay, stable top-k, cache salt and verbose dumps from the production recipe. Retain NUMA placement and the existing model/runtime fixes.

## Related Issue

Follow-up to merged PRs #1750, #1751 and #1756. R3 support from #1496 will be handled separately.

- Full `pre-commit run --all-files` and commit hooks: passed.
- CPU regression suite, 23 changed/adjacent modules: **948 passed, 4 skipped** in 122.03s. Covers proxy token/image preservation, Arena retries and grouped rollouts, frozen parameters and vision checkpoints, CP compatibility, optimizer configuration, transport and colocated pause handling.
- Skips: two vLLM parser cases (vLLM unavailable), one CUDA-only test, and one configuration test requiring exactly the supported Core 0.19.0 runtime. Multi-node GPU integration was not run.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Shared source validation and installation for pinned SGLang patches."""
+
+import argparse
+import fcntl
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import os
+import stat
+import tempfile
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def patch_source(
+    source: bytes,
+    *,
+    target_relative: Path,
+    replacements_by_sha256: Mapping[str, Sequence[tuple[str, str]]],
+    patched_sha256: str,
+) -> bytes:
+    before = hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()
+    if before == patched_sha256:
+        return source
+    if before not in replacements_by_sha256:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Unknown SGLang {target_relative.name} source; refusing to modify"
+        )
+    text = source.decode()
+    for old, new in replacements_by_sha256[before]:
+        if text.count(old) != 1:
+            raise RuntimeError("Expected exactly one source replacement site")
+        text = text.replace(old, new)
+    patched = text.encode()
+    if hashlib.sha256(patched).hexdigest() != patched_sha256:
+        raise RuntimeError("Patched SGLang source does not match validated source")
+    compile(patched, str(target_relative), "exec")
+    return patched
+
+
+def installed_sglang_root() -> Path:
+    """Locate the current interpreter's installation without importing SGLang."""
+    spec = importlib.util.find_spec("sglang")
+    if spec is None or spec.origin is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("SGLang is not installed; pass --target for a source copy")
+    return Path(spec.origin).parent
+
+
+def _atomic_write(target: Path, source: bytes) -> None:
+    temporary = None
+    try:
+        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
+            dir=target.parent, prefix=f".{target.name}.", delete=False
+        ) as stream:
+            temporary = Path(stream.name)
+            stream.write(source)
+            os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), stat.S_IMODE(target.stat().st_mode))
+        os.replace(temporary, target)
+    finally:
+        if temporary is not None:
+            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
+
+def install_source_patches(
+    targets: Sequence[tuple[Path, Callable[[bytes], bytes]]], *, lock_path: Path
+) -> None:
+    """Validate the whole set before atomically installing any changed file.
+
+    Concurrent starts share a lock. Fully patched installations require no writes,
+    including no lock-file creation, so they also work on read-only filesystems.
+    """
+
+    def prepare() -> list[tuple[Path, bytes]]:
+        changes = []
+        for target, transform in targets:
+            source = target.read_bytes()
+            patched = transform(source)
+            if patched != source:
+                changes.append((target, patched))
+        return changes
+
+    if not prepare():
+        return
+    try:
+        with lock_path.open("a") as lock:
+            fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
+            # A concurrent start may have installed the patches while we waited.
+            for target, patched in prepare():
+                _atomic_write(target, patched)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"Cannot install SGLang patches at {lock_path.parent}; "
+            "use a writable installation or prepatched runtime"
+        ) from exc
+
+
+def patch_installed_module(
+    description: str | None,
+    target_relative: Path,
+    transform: Callable[[bytes], bytes],
+) -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=description)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--target", type=Path, help=f"Disposable {target_relative.name} copy"
+    )
+    target = parser.parse_args().target
+    if target is None:
+        root = installed_sglang_root()
+        target = root / target_relative
+    else:
+        root = target.parent
+    install_source_patches(
+        [(target, transform)], lock_path=root / ".areal-sglang-patches.lock"
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Apply validated model-specific patches before starting an SGLang server."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from areal.engine._sglang_source_patch import (
+    install_source_patches,
+    installed_sglang_root,
+)
+
+_BOOTSTRAP = "areal.engine.sglang_model_patches"
+_ENTRYPOINTS = (
+    "areal.v2.inference_service.sglang.launch_server",
+    "areal.engine.awex.sglang_plugin",
+    "sglang.launch_server",
+)
+
+
+def wrap_server_command(command: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+    """Run preparation in the server's interpreter, preserving its chosen entry."""
+    if len(command) < 3 or command[1] != "-m" or command[2] not in _ENTRYPOINTS:
+        return command
+    return [
+        *command[:2],
+        _BOOTSTRAP,
+        "--entrypoint",
+        command[2],
+        "--",
+        *command[3:],
+    ]
+
+
+def apply_model_patches(server_args: Sequence[str]) -> None:
+    """Patch Qwen Flash Next (qwen4_exp), independent of model path or workflow."""
+    if "--help" in server_args or "-h" in server_args:
+        return
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False, allow_abbrev=False)
+    parser.add_argument("--model-path", "--model")
+    parser.add_argument("--revision")
+    args, _ = parser.parse_known_args(server_args)
+    if not args.model_path:
+        return  # Allow the original entry point to handle --help/argument errors.
+    if args.model_path.lower() in ("none", "dummy"):
+        return
+    model_path = Path(args.model_path).expanduser()
+    if model_path.is_file():
+        if model_path.suffix != ".json":
+            return  # GGUF and other binary formats use SGLang's own config loader.
+        config_path = model_path
+    else:
+        config_path = model_path / "config.json"
+    if config_path.is_file():
+        config = json.loads(config_path.read_text())
+    else:
+        if "://" in args.model_path:
+            return  # Connectors normalize remote storage paths inside SGLang.
+        # Raw config access needs no custom model registration or remote code.
+        from transformers import PretrainedConfig
+
+        try:
+            config, _ = PretrainedConfig.get_config_dict(
+                args.model_path, revision=args.revision
+            )
+        except (OSError, ValueError):
+            return  # Let the original entry point handle other config formats.
+    if config.get("model_type") != "qwen4_exp":
+        return
+
+    from areal.engine import (
+        sglang_mm_executor,
+        sglang_qsa_compress_gather,
+        sglang_qwen4_vl,
+    )
+
+    root = installed_sglang_root()
+    patches = (sglang_mm_executor, sglang_qsa_compress_gather, sglang_qwen4_vl)
+    install_source_patches(
+        [(root / patch.TARGET_RELATIVE, patch.patched_source) for patch in patches],
+        lock_path=root / ".areal-sglang-patches.lock",
+    )
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, allow_abbrev=False)
+    parser.add_argument("--entrypoint", required=True, choices=_ENTRYPOINTS)
+    parser.add_argument("server_args", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    server_args = args.server_args
+    if server_args[:1] == ["--"]:
+        server_args = server_args[1:]
+    apply_model_patches(server_args)
+    # Exec preserves PID and the original __main__/multiprocessing spawn behavior.
+    os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, "-m", args.entrypoint, *server_args])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def _compacted_session(chain_lengths=(71, 1, 15)) -> InteractionCache:
+    """Observed topology, including a rejected Summary followed by another."""
+    cache = InteractionCache()
+    start = 1
+    for chain_index, length in enumerate(chain_lengths):
+        stop = start + length
+        system = "solve" if chain_index in (0, len(chain_lengths) - 1) else "summary"
+        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system}]
+        input_tokens = [1]
+        for index in range(start, stop):
+            messages = messages + [{"role": "user", "content": f"input-{index}"}]
+            input_tokens = input_tokens + [2]
+            output = [{"role": "assistant", "content": f"output-{index}"}]
+            turn = InteractionWithTokenLogpReward(
+                messages=messages,
+                output_message_list=output,
+                chat_template_type="concat",
+                model_response=ModelResponse(
+                    input_tokens=input_tokens,
+                    output_tokens=[index + 10],
+                    output_logprobs=[-0.1],
+                    output_versions=[0],
+                ),
+            )
+            turn.interaction_id = str(index)
+            cache[str(index)] = turn
+            messages = messages + output
+            input_tokens = input_tokens + [index + 10]
+        start = stop
+    return cache

+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from areal.models.mcore.vision_checkpoint import checkpoint_qwen3_5_vision_blocks
+
+
+class VisionBlock(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(2.0))
+        self.forward_calls = 0
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        position_embeddings: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
+        cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        self.forward_calls += 1
+        cosine, sine = position_embeddings
+        return hidden_states * self.weight * cosine + sine + cu_seqlens[-1]
+
+
+class Qwen3_5VisionModel(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([VisionBlock(), VisionBlock()])
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        cosine = torch.full_like(hidden_states, 0.5)
+        sine = torch.full_like(hidden_states, 0.25)
+        cu_seqlens = torch.tensor([0, hidden_states.numel()])
+        for block in self.blocks:
+            hidden_states = block(
+                hidden_states,
+                position_embeddings=(cosine, sine),
+                cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens,
+            )
+        return hidden_states
+
+

+    namespace = {}

+        namespace,
+    )
+    runner = namespace["ProcessorRunner"]()
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
+
+        async def run(function, *args, **kwargs):
+            return await asyncio.get_running_loop().run_in_executor(

+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Unknown SGLang"):
+        patch.main()
+    assert target.read_bytes() == before
+

+    assert patch.patched_source(patched) == patched
+
+
+def test_valid_multimodal_call_preserves_arguments_and_result(run_processor):

+        return value * multiplier, processor["image_size"]
+
+    async def scenario():
+        return await run_processor(process, 7, multiplier=3)
+
+    assert asyncio.run(scenario()) == (21, 32)
+
+
+def test_exhausted_iterator_finishes_request_and_releases_lock(run_processor):
+    async def scenario():
+        lock = asyncio.Lock()
+        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        original_handler = loop.get_exception_handler()
+        loop_errors = []
+        loop.set_exception_handler(lambda _loop, context: loop_errors.append(context))
+
+        def process(*, processor):
+            return next(iter(()))
+
+        async def request():
+            async with lock:
+                return await run_processor(process)
+
+        try:
+            with pytest.raises(

+            ) as caught:
+                await asyncio.wait_for(request(), timeout=2)

+            assert not loop_errors

+            assert (
+                await run_processor(lambda *, processor: "next request")

+            )
+        finally:

What is the purpose of this file?
Removed the internal recovery design document in [697da6f89](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/commit/697da6f89fe060e09ae2c1e10f5b707561841c45).

This addresses a generic SGLang multimodal executor issue: StopIteration from a preprocessing thread cannot be propagated into an asyncio Future, so the request can remain pending and retain its reader lock. It is independent of SWE and Qwen.

Moved the implementation to `areal/engine/sglang_mm_executor.py` in [697da6f89](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/commit/697da6f89fe060e09ae2c1e10f5b707561841c45), with the reusable entry point `python -m areal.engine.sglang_mm_executor`. The recipe now invokes that command; the old example entry point forwards to it for compatibility. Application remains explicit and checksum-guarded for the validated executor revision, so other multimodal recipes can use it without patching unknown SGLang versions.

The executor tests cover successful calls, exception propagation, releasing the request lock, and processing the next request after an exhausted iterator.

This is an unmodified snapshot of `sglang/srt/multimodal/processors/executor.py` from the validated rollout build `0.5.19.dev125+g119b5ffe4`. The compatibility patch checks the exact source SHA-256, and the regression tests compile these bytes without importing SGLang. They reproduce the thread-to-asyncio StopIteration failure and verify that the patched request finishes, releases its lock, and allows a subsequent request to succeed. They also check normal calls, idempotence, and rejection of unknown sources.

Added `tests/fixtures/README.md` with provenance, checksum, and test purpose in [697da6f89](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/commit/697da6f89fe060e09ae2c1e10f5b707561841c45). The fixture bytes remain unchanged because they are the checksum-validated input to the patch.

Removed the executor source snapshot and its fixture README in c06d26b38cf13f845a27b8199ea61b08b18d52ea. The regression now uses only a minimal processor call site with a real single-worker ThreadPoolExecutor and asyncio loop. It still checks StopIteration conversion, timely request completion, lock release, subsequent request reuse, normal results and preservation of other exception types.

The same commit removes the two remaining internal design notes and consolidates source revision validation, replacements and the --target installation entry point for the executor, Qwen4 image and QSA patches into areal.engine._sglang_source_patch. The model-specific fixes stay separate; their patched output is byte-for-byte identical to the previous implementation on the installed pinned runtime. Qwen legacy upgrades and the existing QSA reapplication policy are preserved.

Validation: 35 relevant CPU tests and 8 real-image roundtrip cases passed. Full pre-commit --all-files and normal commit hooks passed.

Follow-up cleanup in [7aedba444](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/commit/7aedba444d45ba66eb5580de8159af61ec447297).

The sole executor entry point remains `python -m areal.engine.sglang_mm_executor`, since the failure crosses the processor-thread/asyncio boundary independently of model and workflow. Removed the unused Qwen example forwarding module. The shared installer remains explicit: importing AReaL does not modify SGLang, and unknown source revisions are rejected before writing.
